correctness.rationale: Independently rederived cone containment c²>=a²+cot²(theta)b² and ball norm quadratic q(u)=c²+b²+2cau+(a²-b²)u². Both proposed branches saturate cone/ball; for theta<=asin(1/sqrt d) ball contact is tip, above it latitude u=gamma/d. Source explicit positive John-contact weights on ± coordinate transverse directions obey sum lambda z=0 and sum lambda zz^T=I, yielding global volume optimality among all ellipsoids, not mere axial candidates. Independently checked all moment and containment equalities in d=2,3,5,9 and two regimes. The log-volume branches agree through first derivative and have second derivative jump -2d.
